text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, while integration tests make sure different parts work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and improve the design. Good tests give developers confidence. When they change the code, they can quickly see if something breaks. Without tests, making changes becomes risky and stressful. In short, testing is not a waste of time but a smart investment in quality.
